arguments.name: electorateCode
arguments.description: The electorate code to search for (e.g.: "000002")

raw.name: electorateCode
raw.description: The electorate code to search for (e.g.: "000002")

arguments.name: electorateName
arguments.description: The electorate name to search for (e.g.: "hSenid")

raw.name: electorateName
raw.description: The electorate name to search for (e.g.: "hSenid")

arguments.name: districtName
arguments.description: District name to search for. Uses criteria D.DISTRICT_NAME. Partial match, case-insensitive.

raw.name: districtName
raw.description: District name to search for. Uses criteria D.DISTRICT_NAME. Partial match, case-insensitive.

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
"yes" to return all electorates (uses Show All).
Also auto-triggers when electorateCode / electorateName / districtName is: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
"yes" to return all electorates (uses Show All).
Also auto-triggers when electorateCode / electorateName / districtName is: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".

arguments.name: fetchDetails
arguments.description:
"yes" / "no" (default "yes").
If exactly 1 result and "yes", opens record and returns detailed values.

raw.name: fetchDetails
raw.description:
"yes" / "no" (default "yes").
If exactly 1 result and "yes", opens record and returns detailed values.

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description:
Page size used during initial grid load/search (example: "10", "50").
The tool will still adapt to UI page size after the first response.

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description:
Page size used during initial grid load/search (example: "10", "50").
The tool will still adapt to UI page size after the first response.

arguments.name: matchMode
arguments.description:
Name matching behavior when searching by electorateName or districtName:
"contains" (default) → partial match
"exact" → exact match only

raw.name: matchMode
raw.description:
Name matching behavior when searching by electorateName or districtName:
"contains" (default) → partial match
"exact" → exact match only
